title: approvals: the action-page contract docblock and ADR-0043 still describe the email-link reject without its required reason
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · contract review 7101851923 on PR #36695 (#35722), nit N1, filed on seat 3's request (#32588 comment 7101877978). Parent topic #36243.

## What is wrong

PR #36695 made the email action-link reject require a typed reason. Two texts still describe the old behaviour:

- `packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`: the docblock for `IApprovalService.handleActionPage` says the POST reads only `token` and answers the result page. It now also reads `comment`, and it can answer the confirm page with `400` (`reason_required`).
- ADR-0043 still lists comment capture on the confirm page under Non-goals, as not shipped.

## Done when

- The docblock names `comment` and the `400` / `reason_required` confirm-page answer.
- ADR-0043 gets an add-only note: comment capture shipped for reject in #36695.

Triage: lands in `area:workflow` · `domain:spec` · `priority:p2` · Task · `pm:queue`; rationale: the spec contract ships in `@objectstack/spec` and is what authors and the AI read, so a wrong sentence there is p2 under the table (wrong shipped text). Behaviour is correct.
